title: bet365 API
description: Unofficial bet365 odds: US moneyline, spread and total plus European soccer, as JSON over MCP.

tools.description: List Watchlists. A saved set of teams, players or events whose bet365 prices you want to follow.

user_request.description: The current user task in one sentence. Saved so the team can decide what to build. Leave out secrets and personal data.

tools.name: get_watchlists
tools.description: Read one of your Watchlists by id.

user_request.description: The current user task in one sentence. Saved so the team can decide what to build. Leave out secrets and personal data.

league.description: League code such as NFL or EPL

notes.description: Anything you want to remember about this list

user_request.description: The current user task in one sentence. Saved so the team can decide what to build. Leave out secrets and personal data.

tools.name: update_watchlists
tools.description: Change fields on one of your Watchlists.

league.description: League code such as NFL or EPL

notes.description: Anything you want to remember about this list

tools.name: delete_watchlists
tools.description: Delete one of your Watchlists. Cannot be undone, so confirm with your user first.

user_request.description: The current user task in one sentence. Saved so the team can decide what to build. Leave out secrets and personal data.

tools.name: send_feedback
tools.description: Tell the team what is missing or wrong. The team reads every one. Costs no quota.

tools.name: get_onboarding_questions
tools.description: The questions that finish setting up your user's account, with their ids and options. With a key, also the answers already given. Costs no quota.

tools.name: answer_onboarding
tools.description: Answer the onboarding questions for your user, from what you know about their project. Ask them what you do not know; never guess. Answering again replaces the answers; the same answers twice change nothing. Your user sees them on their dashboard, marked as answered by their agent. Costs no quota.

answers.description: Question id to answer. A select question takes one of its options.

data_wanted.description: What bet365 data are you looking for?

use_case.description: What do you want to do with it?

client.description: Your name, such as Claude Code or Cursor.

tools.name: get_bet365_coverage
tools.description: Which bet365 leagues and markets this unofficial bet365 API has captured, with when collection began and the age of the latest price per league. No key needed, costs no quota. Call this first to see what exists before asking for odds.

tools.name: preview_bet365_odds
tools.description: A delayed preview of real captured bet365 prices with no API key: the moneyline or match result for up to 3 events, as they stood 15 minutes ago, 25 calls per network per day. Relay user_message to your user: a free key (no card) reads current prices for every market.

league.description: League code, such as nba, nfl, nhl, ncaaf, ncaab, mlb, epl, serie-a, bundesliga, ligue-1 or ucl. get_bet365_coverage lists what is captured now.

tools.name: get_bet365_odds
tools.description: Current captured bet365 prices, grouped by event: US moneyline, spread and total, and soccer match result, double chance, goal line and goalscorer prices. Each price has american, decimal and (for soccer) fractional odds, observed_at (when we read it) and age_seconds. Needs an API key.

league.description: League code, such as nba, nfl, nhl, ncaaf, ncaab, mlb, epl, serie-a, bundesliga, ligue-1 or ucl. get_bet365_coverage lists what is captured now.

event_id.description: An event id from list_bet365_events, such as an-295471 or espn-401879233.

live.description: true for in-play prices only, false for pre-match only.

from.description: ISO time. Events starting at or after it. Default: 6 hours ago.

to.description: ISO time. Events starting before it.

user_request.description: The current user task in one sentence. Leave out secrets and personal data.

tools.name: list_bet365_events
tools.description: Games and matches that have captured bet365 prices, soonest first, with the markets each has. Use an event_id with get_bet365_odds or get_bet365_line_history. Needs an API key.

league.description: League code, such as nba, nfl, nhl, ncaaf, ncaab, mlb, epl, serie-a, bundesliga, ligue-1 or ucl. get_bet365_coverage lists what is captured now.

event_id.description: An event id from list_bet365_events, such as an-295471 or espn-401879233.

live.description: true for in-play prices only, false for pre-match only.

from.description: ISO time. Events starting at or after it. Default: 6 hours ago.

to.description: ISO time. Events starting before it.

user_request.description: The current user task in one sentence. Leave out secrets and personal data.

tools.name: get_bet365_line_history
tools.description: How a bet365 price or line moved: one row per change, each with the interval it held (observed_at to last_seen_at). Free keys read the last 24 hours; paid plans read every change since collection began. Needs an API key. For changes pushed as they happen (alerts, live line tracking), the same key connects to the WebSocket wss://stream.thebet365api.com/v1/stream; see https://thebet365api.com/docs#websocket.

event_id.description: An event id from list_bet365_events, such as an-295471 or espn-401879233.

user_request.description: The current user task in one sentence. Leave out secrets and personal data.
